Our GPA calc tool is completely free to use. Calculate your grade point average instantly without any hidden fees or registration requirements. Perfect for students who need quick and accurate GPA calculations.

Easy to Use Interface

Simple and intuitive design makes GPA calculation effortless. Just enter your grades and credit hours, and our GPA calc tool does the rest. No complex formulas or confusing interfaces.

How to Calculate GPA
Enter your course grades (A, B, C, D, F or numeric)
Input the credit hours for each course
Our GPA calc tool automatically calculates your grade point average
View your semester GPA and cumulative GPA results
Save your data to track progress over time

GPA Calc Formula: Total grade points ÷ Total credit hours = GPA
